title:
C
  
    3
  -symmetric aromatic triimides as useful building blocks for supramolecular chemistry and advanced materials
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00892H, Review Article
De-Hui Tuo, Xu-Dong Wang, De-Xian Wang
This review summarizes the synthetic strategies, structural and electronic features, and applications of C3-symmetric aromatic triimides in supramolecular chemistry and advanced materials, emphasizing their potential to drive future innovations.
